intro: This errand directs dwarven paladins wandering abroad to return home to Ironforge to further their sacred calling. Offered by Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in Stormwind, it points fledgling champions toward Tiza Battleforge, one of the most respected instructors in the Hall of Mysteries. Returning home marks the beginning of their formal trials with the Tome of Divinity.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hello, friend. I know you're busy helping out the people of Azeroth, but when you have the time, you should return to Ironforge and speak to one of the most respected paladins of your home: Tiza Battleforge. She's the one the younger dwarven paladins go to when it is time they learn more about the Light and what's expected of all of us.
You can find her upstairs in the Hall of Mysteries which is located in the Mystic Ward.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I greet you, and bid you welcome, friend.
